description:
Run a non-medical home care agency from 8 Excel workbooks: quotes, schedule, visits, caregiver pay, invoices, recruiting and cash. One payment of 29 dollars, no subscription, no macros.

You run a small agency, pay for software every month (often per client or per caregiver) and cannot see which client loses money.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
✓ Find the clients who earn less than your target margin, and the rate that fixes it
✓ Fill open shifts with the best-matched caregiver; see overtime before payroll
✓ Compare check-in times with the schedule and find hours paid but never billed
✓ Check the pay run line by line: overtime, holiday pay, travel, mileage
✓ Phone the right balances first; track every payer claim to payment
✓ See cash 13 weeks ahead and the largest owner draw above your cash floor

WHAT IS INSIDE: 8 WORKBOOKS FOR ONE AGENCY
1 Enquiries, Quotes and Agreements
2 Schedule, Matching and Cover
3 Visits, Hours and Travel
4 Caregiver Payroll and Overtime
5 Client Invoices, Deposits and Payers
6 Recruiting, Onboarding and Renewals
7 Client Margin and Hours Growth
8 Owner Money and Business Health
Each workbook has 20 tables, 18 tools, 12 forms, 12 documents, 12 checklists, 34 ready message texts, 30 dashboard numbers, 22 charts and 6 gauges. In all: 144 tools, 160 tables, 96 forms and 272 message texts on {pages} ready pages. Each part is a blank workbook plus a copy with sample data.

WHO IT IS FOR
Owners, schedulers, office managers and recruiters of a small agency with private-pay clients and some third-party payers (insurers, public bodies). An owner who also does visits can use the quote, schedule, invoice, pay and cash parts.
NOT FOR: live tracking, an app, GPS or automatic check-in, a client portal, care plans or care notes, or filing payer claims. You type or paste check-in times; files hold service types, hours, dates and amounts only.

HOW IT WORKS
1 Open the workbook for the job.
2 Replace the sample rows with your own.
3 Read the dashboard and use the tools.
Instructions are on the first sheet. Formula cells are locked (no password).

FILE FORMAT
Standard .xlsx files for Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets and LibreOffice, made with the same engine as our earlier suites (tested in Google Sheets). No macros, no subscription. Dates follow your computer's regional format; the currency symbol changes in one cell.

GUARANTEE
If a file does not work as described, we fix it, replace it or refund you within 14 days.

More answers: see the FAQ.

faq.q: Do I need special software? Does it work in Google Sheets?
faq.a: No. The files are standard .xlsx files for Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets and LibreOffice. They are made with the same engine as our earlier suites, which we tested in Google Sheets. There are no macros and no subscription.

faq.q: I run a small agency on my own and do visits myself. Is it for me?
faq.a: Yes, in part. Use the enquiry and quote, schedule, invoice, pay and cash workbooks, and the one-person capacity check shows your free hours before you say yes. The recruiting tools can stay empty until you hire. Part 8 has a start-up page that says which pages to use at your size.

faq.q: Can I use my own currency and date format?
faq.a: Yes. Amounts are plain numbers and the currency symbol can be changed in one cell. Dates follow the regional format of your computer.

faq.q: Can I replace the sample data with my own?
faq.a: Yes. Every part comes as a blank workbook plus a copy filled with sample data, so you can explore first and start clean. Input cells are coloured, formula cells are locked against accidental edits (no password) and instructions are on the first sheet.

faq.q: Does it replace home care software?
faq.a: Not entirely. It has no app, live tracking, GPS, automatic check-in, client portal or claim filing. You type or paste check-in times and it compares them with the schedule. It gives you the reports owners need for one payment of 29 dollars, with no per-client or per-caregiver fee.

faq.q: What if a file does not work as described?
faq.a: We fix it, replace it or refund you within 14 days.
